messages:
jamie: Heads up — planned PK swap + new covering index on users.email during tomorrow's 02:00 UTC change window. This will need a short writes quiesce for the PK swap. Full plan below.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/2026.03.21-db-index at 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. Jobs: migrate-users-pk-swap, build-users-email-idx. Triggered by jamie.

akash: quick Q — how long did the locks hold in staging when you ran the swap?

db-admin: Staging notes: 5M rows. PK swap exclusive lock ~90s on that shard. CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ran ~12m and didn't block writes. We used chunked denorm backfill for two columns: ~6m/chunk. Production scale expect up to ~2min for critical rename/lock ops, 10-20m for concurrent index builds depending on IO.

lina: Can we avoid the exclusive lock entirely? CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY helps but a true PK swap needs constraint rename. Any alternative?

jamie: Proposal: canary on shard-3 only with 5% write traffic pinned to release v2.7.1. Steps: 1) flip feature flag to route writes for shard-3 to canary hosts, 2) run migration for shard-3, 3) monitor for 15m, if OK roll to other shards with rolling quiesce. Also pin client DB driver to 3.14 during rollout (newer driver retries change behavior).

migrate-bot: Runbook excerpt:
```
# quiesce writers for shard-3
curl -X POST https://internal-flips/flags/disable-writes -d '{"scope":"users_pk_swap_shard_3"}'
# run migration
./migrate --env=prod --target=users_pk_swap --shard=shard-3 --timeout=30m
# verify index build status
psql -c "SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='users'"
```

akash: Rollback criteria proposal: 95p latency spike >200ms OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR replication lag >30s. If any trigger, immediate rollback and abort further shards. Agreed?

rachel-oncall: :eyes: I'll set up pagers: error-rate >0.5% for 3m -> page oncall, 95p latency >250ms -> page. I'll also add a dashboard row for replication lag and a simple playbook for quick revert.

db-admin: Quick revert commands (prepped):
```
-- rename constraint back to previous PK if needed
ALTER TABLE users RENAME CONSTRAINT users_pkey_new TO users_pkey;
-- fallback: restore from snapshot 'pre-pk-swap' if constraints irrecoverable
```

lina: Add to release notes: pin DB client to 3.14, feature flag name users_pk_swap_shard_3, rollback criteria and revert commands. Also call out expected index build time and impact on replica catch-up.

jamie: Change window set 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary 02:00-02:20 on shard-3 (5% traffic). If healthy, roll remaining shards in 10-15m batches with 5m monitoring between. I'll update the release notes and post the final checklist here. Any objections to the window?

akash: No objections. I'll be in the channel and on standby.

deploy-bot: Deployment started by jamie at 2026-03-21T02:00:05Z (automated message).

rachel-oncall: Added pager rules and a short checklist to the incident runbook: preflight checks @23:30 UTC tonight (index stats, replica lag, API pinned), live monitoring -> if any alert, run revert commands and notify infra.

jamie: I'll run a final preflight at 23:30 UTC tonight. Posting the preflight checklist in #eng-releases after that. Thanks all — keep phones nearby. :shipit:
